units.source_text: 这个阿绢和阿时，以及她们同客人之间出的事，在整个贵客盈门的夏天，只有这么两桩。

en.t: In the whole summer crowded with honored guests, there were only these two incidents involving O-Kinu and O-Toki and what happened between them and the guests.

units.source_text: 姐妹当中，反而只有这两个并不艳丽的人发生了这等事。

en.t: Among the sisters, ironically, only these two, who were not especially glamorous, had such things happen to them.
